changeSet.sql: UPDATE theme SET layout = jsonb_set( jsonb_set( layout, '{tiles,ride}', $J${"col": 17, "row": 14, "colSpan": 9, "rowSpan": 9, "edition": "map"}$J$::jsonb ), '{mobileOrder}', $J$["music", "latestDrop", "photoDrops", "ride", "projects", "waveSwitcher"]$J$::jsonb ) WHERE key = 'wave-03';
